parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, small rectangular shape, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as a control lever to adjust the water flow or temperature by rotating or lifting.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt slightly to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Frame (Mounting Plate)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame or mounting plate of the faucet, made of stainless steel, rectangular in shape, supporting the spout and switches.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and connects the faucet assembly to the wall or sink.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, elongated rectangular shape, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may swivel in some designs.

parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, small rectangular shape, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as a control lever to adjust the water flow or temperature by rotating or lifting.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt slightly to open or close the water valve.
